system.description:
When you select this archetype at level 1, the damage dealt by your Sanguine Transference is either fire or cold. Which damage type it deals is determined by which court (fire for Summer or cold for Winter) the fey whose blood you are transfused with was aligned with. Once this choice is made at character creation, it cannot be changed.

Additionally, choose one of the following:

Deft Defenses

When you are not wearing armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Intelligence modifier. You also gain an expertise die to your initiative roll.

Dazzling Strike

When you hit an enemy creature with a melee weapon attack, glittering particles bursts from your weapon and the target creature becomes dazzled until the end of your next turn. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
